findings.text: Item 2 ("the answer goes ON the card") works only after a reload: a live `{"q-…":{answer}}` write never redraws the Question's row (`Task.replay_line` → `take()` → `Item.put()`, no "delta"), as the worker documents at ext/Chat/v3/readme.md:373 and ChatV3.test.mjs:283. The owner watches the chat live, so this is item 2 unmet. The fix is not big: ChatV3 could refill the owning Prompt card inside `refresh_refs()`/`update()`, or `take()` could emit. Parking it as "out of fence" is not enough.

The reference box drifts off the end of the chat. `update()` appends each new root with `this.$box.append(...)` (ChatV3.js:145), which puts it after `.chat-v3-refs`. `refresh_refs()` only re-appends the box when it is disconnected (ChatV3.js:293), so after the first reference every new card lands BELOW the references. Item 3 says "near the end".

"Far-off" is computed as "its Prompt is not the newest root" (placement.js:326-329), with no look at when the answer landed. A question answered right away still gets a reference as soon as the next prompt arrives, and every answered question in the session piles up at the bottom for good. Item 3 is only "the answer lands long after the question, other content in between": compare the cards created after the Prompt with `answer.at`, or cap the list.

Item 4 says "links to its existing card", but the guard only refuses the write (page_tools.js:1394-1399). Nothing links the repeated sentence to the existing card. session-smart.md:117 just says the refusal exists and gives no step for what to do with `existing` (for example, a reply or anchor on the new Prompt pointing at `#<id>`). The refusal also throws away every other part of the same delta (a refined title or text sent alongside it) without saying so.

The brief asked for `ext/Chat/v3/doc/question-cards.md`, linked from v3/readme.md, plus a pointer in ux/Dictate/readme.md. Neither exists (`v3/doc/` does not exist). The brief's own "No dated logs" rule is broken by the "KNOWN GAP … (ask7, 2026-11-03)" paragraph at v3/readme.md:373-381, which belongs in that doc.

Readme lines now stale. ux/Dictate/readme.md:37 still says only "A Question card moves to the end of the chat when answered", with no word that V3 keeps the card in place. session-smart.md:115 still says "Planned, not built yet … the answered card will move to the newest end", which contradicts what V3 now does.

A fresh agent can't continue from this task folder. The live folder holds only requirements.md and review/. There is no task.jsonl log (the brief: "Log in task.jsonl in this folder"), and no one-screen report with file:line, test counts and what is unproven. plan.md exists only in the worktree.

Item 1 (in place, punctuation fixed) is claimed "already built" in plan.md. The fix-punctuation rule is real (single-voice-assistant.md:7), but no test here proves a Question's text gets its punctuation fixed. Treat it as unproven, not met.
A far-off Question whose Prompt is older than the "show earlier" limit gets a reference whose `#id` has no drawn target (ChatV3.js:262 vs draw()'s `slice(-this.limit)`), so tapping it does nothing.
ChatV3.test.mjs:307 is `check(..., true)`. It passes only because the `waitForFunction` before it would throw; fold the wait into the check so the line reports a real result.

Tests I ran in the worktree: placement.test.mjs 28 passed, 0 failed; Question-dedupe.test.mjs 8 passed. I did not run ChatV3.test.mjs (Playwright). There are no screenshots, although plan.md promised shots at 400/1200 of the reference card.

findings.text: `core/Task/doc/prompt.md:37` still lists Question's `line_fields` as `text, from, answer, working`; this diff adds `also_from` (`core/Task/Question.js:9`) and does not update that doc. The doc is stale, so a fresh agent reading it won't know the link field exists.

`Servex/agents/readme.md:118-119` lists `page_tools.js`'s guards and their tests (for example `task_origin()` / `task-origin.test.mjs`), but the new `strip_duplicate_questions()` guard and `Servex/agents/Question-dedupe.test.mjs` are not listed there. Nothing in Servex's own readme chain points to them (law 10).

`ux/Dictate/doc/question-cards.md` is mostly fix history ("the first pass got wrong…", "a review caught four of eleven findings"). The brief says "No dated logs" and law 9 says a doc should describe how the system works now, with no history. Rewrite it to say what each ask does now and where it is built; the history already lives in `task.jsonl` and `report.md`.

`plan.md:25-27` still says a repeat "refuses the write with `{ok:false, …existing}`". The code now links it through `also_from` instead. A fresh agent who reads the plan before `report.md` gets the old design; add a line at the top of the plan saying it was superseded.

`page_tools.js` `strip_duplicate_questions` matches a re-add of the same Question id, or a repeat under the same Prompt, as a duplicate. That writes the Prompt's own id into `also_from`, so `ChatV3.js` (the `also` filter in `card()`) draws a reference to the card under the very card that holds it. Skip the match when `existing === a.id` or `from` equals the existing Question's own `from`.

When the stripped duplicate was the only thing in the write, `body` keeps a key holding nothing (for example `{"p-2":{}}`). The generic write at `page_tools.js` ~1442 still sends it as a no-op line, because `Object.keys(body).length` counts that key.

The code comments say "Review fix (ask7, finding N)" throughout (`ChatV3.js:43,469,525`, `placement.js:610,631`, `page_tools.js:177,225`). A later reader has no way to look up those finding numbers; the comments should say what the code does, not which round fixed it.
Item 1's punctuation fix depends on the seat brief alone (`Servex/agents/single-voice-assistant.md:7`); no test proves it. The report says so honestly.
